title: OpenWebNetGoldenFrameCorpus
description: Schema for OpenWebNet Golden Corpus test frame records.

id.description: Unique identifier for the golden frame fixture.

frame.description: Raw OpenWebNet frame string starting with '*' and ending with '##'.

who.description: Subsystem WHO code (null for signaling frames).

what.description: Action or state code WHAT (e.g. 1 for ON, 0 for OFF, or combined speed '1#5').

where.description: Target or source address (preserving leading zeros, e.g. '0311', '51').

interface.description: Private bus interface identifier if routed (e.g. '01' from '#4#01').

dimension.description: Dimension index if a dimension frame.

dimension_values.description: Parameters for dimension writing or response frames.

source.description: Authority or provenance of this test frame.

mcp_valid.description: Whether openwebnet-mcp confirmed this frame as legal.

mcp_notes.description: Explanation or validation details from openwebnet-mcp.

roundtrip.description: Whether parsing and re-serializing in OWNd must exactly match the raw frame string.

is_translation.description: Whether this frame is an OpenWebNet Command Translation frame (WHAT=1000).

args.description: Positional arguments to pass to the builder method.
